evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
For the winter semester: until 28 September 2026

notes: Tuition: DAAD page states 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants; the HHN page confirms 'International students from non-EU/EEA countries pay a fee of 1,500 euros per semester.' Duration: 7 semesters = 3.5 years (210 ECTS). Intake: DAAD gives only a winter-semester application deadline of 28 September 2026; HHN gives rolling portal-opening windows ('mid-May for the winter semester'), so no other exact dates could be quoted. Note that the page's own German profile requires German language skills at level B2 (Studienkolleg recognition route via Studienkolleg Konstanz / Uni-Assist applies to international applicants generally, no programme-specific wording).

note.fr: Diplôme étranger : faire reconnaître votre certificat par le Studienkolleg Konstanz ou par Uni-Assist (payant) avant de postuler ; sans reconnaissance, la candidature est exclue.
note.en: Foreign certificate: have your certificate recognized by Studienkolleg Konstanz or by Uni-Assist (fee) before applying; without recognition, the application will not be considered.

evidence.quote: If you hold a non-German school leaving certificate, you must first have it recognized by Studienkolleg Konstanz or by Uni-Assist.
